finding.verdict: independent reconstruction, not a rebase and not a force-push of this work
evidence: The target's tip is not a descendant of the feature base 2068472f9fac2c8f0abe8e0993e3b0ff34da4c33, and the feature's tip is not a descendant of the target's.
Both lineages share one merge base (a4f5df30b68b419887c59a1036be1b2ea28bb3dc, 'Record what Mission 15 demonstrated, and what it did not') and diverge from it independently.

The target never contained src/core/couture/: those modules are ADDED by the feature lineage, so 'the target deletes selection.ts, textiles.ts and sculptural.ts' describes a diff against a sibling, not a deletion by the target.
The target adds a parallel implementation of the same capability under src/core/cosmos/objects/ with a build engine under src/core/creative/kit/build/.
finding.consequence: Nothing was deleted by either side. A merge would leave two competing object stores and two creative tool families, so the reconciliation ports the feature's capability onto the target's architecture instead of merging the trees.
